claim: A verified skill with a unique trigger is RETRIEVED by the runtime router on a task-shaped turn, USED to render the answer with the small local model, GROUNDED-verified before it ships, and the LERF route is VISIBLE in the MRI (and the per-turn LERF route ledger).
owner: anima/lerf.py, anima/lerf_router.py (route_task rungs), anima/server.py (_lerf_eligible/_lerf_task_first LERF-FIRST seam, _record_route), anima/caps.py (grow_intelligence/grow_mode gate Phase-6 GROWTH only — runtime use is independent), anima/web/index.html (lerf_skill search tag)

killer_test.name: unique_trigger_skill_retrieved_used_grounded_traced
killer_test.setup: Seed the shared skill library (default.lerf.json in a hermetic temp store) with ONE active skill carrying a unique trigger phrase. Drive anima.server._turn with a TASK-shaped request that matches only that skill. Assert: _lerf_eligible returns a rung-3 lerf_skill route for the unique trigger (and returns None for a feeling/personal/conversational turn — the #1-rule exclusion holds); the rendered answer is grounded-verified (router rung-5 small_local_verified, grounded True) BEFORE shipping; backend is lerf:*; and the LERF route ledger line + the whole_mri trace record lerf.solved True for this turn. Real .anima byte-unchanged.
killer_test.prompt: <the skill's unique trigger phrase, e.g. 'run the zorptangle triage checklist on this'>
must_contain: <a token the skill's contract REQUIRES in its output>
must_not_contain: <a fabricated figure not present in the request>

known_gaps: Requires a real verified skill present in the shared library AND the small local model (Ollama) up to render it; with no model the seam withholds and escalates (no false solve). A hermetic no-model variant can still prove retrieval+eligibility+grounded-verify wiring deterministically, but the USE-in-answer link needs the live small model.
killer_test prompt/tokens are placeholders pending selection of a concrete certified skill with a genuinely unique trigger (so a generic LLM fallback cannot fake the 'retrieved + used' claim).
